answer: Each agent must stake tokens that are locked before it can claim a place in the economy; actions earn fees only after counterparties confirm delivery, and proven fraud slashes the stake. A newcomer may call its profile yarrow, marble, or zephyr, but names confer no trust: splitting one identity into many does not multiply capital. A sybil attacker must fund every account separately, tying up scarce tokens and risking permanent loss for each fake that misbehaves.
